weapon.name: Storm Scepter
weapon.weaponLine: A one-handed sceptre, attuned to Storm, swung in melee. It can go in either hand, or one in each.
weapon.handNote: It can go in either hand, or one in each.
weapon.elementNote: Storm — a hit also sets Shocked, and the target takes 30% more damage from every source for 5s.
weapon.attackText: Basic attack: a melee swing that deals lightning damage instead of physical. Hits leave Shocked. It never throws a bolt.

active.name: Two Good Legs
active.text: You've a weapon and two good legs, which makes you the most useful person in Torborhold this week. Before I send you anywhere far, prove the legs work: the moor hounds are at the sheep folds again. Then go out to the Drill Field by the gate and find whoever teaches your sort of trouble.
active.done: Good. You came back, and with all your fingers. That's more than the last three. Now, a real errand.

steps.text: Kill 3 moor hounds near the sheep folds
steps.where: the sheep folds and open grass just outside Torborhold
Torbor Drill Field, just outside Torborhold's gate

reward.text: A purse of coin, and the Elder's next errand: the south road.

bar.name: Mend
bar.desc: Heals you (or the party member you target) for 35% of maximum health. Every other ally heals 20% of their maximum health. Healing past your maximum becomes a barrier, up to 10% of maximum health. All allies = you, party members within 30 m and your followers (your own pets, summons and hired blades).
bar.targets: the party member you target (or you), and all allies

bar.name: Sunlance
bar.desc: Fires a 1.4 m wide beam 24 m straight ahead, striking everything in the line for 174% weapon damage as holy. Each enemy hit heals all allies 2% of maximum health. Marks targets with Lit for 3s: they take 10% more damage from you. All allies = you, party members within 30 m and your followers (your own pets, summons and hired blades).

bar.name: Raise the Fallen
bar.desc: Raises every fallen party member within 30 m at 50% health. 4s cast: moving cancels it and nothing is spent. Cannot be cast while a monster is attacking you. The fallen player chooses whether to stand up. Gives you Rallied: you deal 20% more damage and take 15% less damage for 8s. All allies get the same. Every other ally heals 30% of their maximum health. Revives all your own fallen followers at once at 50% health. All allies = you, party members within 30 m and your followers (your own pets, summons and hired blades).
bar.targets: every fallen party member within 30 m

bar.name: Sanctuary
bar.desc: Lands on a spot up to 20 m away. Places a zone 10 m across where you aim for 6s, healing all allies inside 3% of maximum health every 1s, pushing enemies inside 2 m outward every second. All allies = you, party members within 30 m and your followers (your own pets, summons and hired blades).

bar.name: Guardian Light
bar.desc: Summons 1 Guardian Light for 20s; it takes no follower slot; it heals the most-hurt ally 6% every 2s. All allies = you, party members within 30 m and your followers (your own pets, summons and hired blades).

bar.name: Falling Light
bar.desc: Falls on a spot up to 28 m away, 0.7s after you cast, striking everything within 3.5 m of that spot for 864% weapon damage as holy. Places a zone 7 m across where you aim for 1s, healing all allies inside 10% of maximum health every 1s. Deals 50% more damage to Lit targets. All allies = you, party members within 30 m and your followers (your own pets, summons and hired blades).

nodes.desc: Strips 18 armour from what it hits, and the armour does not come back. What it hits takes 15% more damage from every source for 5s.

nodes.name: Rising Ward
nodes.desc: All allies get a barrier worth 15% of your maximum health for 8s. All allies = you, party members within 30 m and your followers (your own pets, summons and hired blades).

nodes.name: Echo
nodes.desc: 1 cast in 6 fires a second time, free.

nodes.name: Raised in Wrath
nodes.desc: For 10s, your followers: +30% damage. Your followers = your own pets, summons and hired blades, never other players.

nodes.name: Shared Breath
nodes.desc: On cast, heals all allies within it 20% of maximum health. All allies = you, party members within 30 m and your followers (your own pets, summons and hired blades).

nodes.name: Bulwark
nodes.desc: Casting it gives you a barrier worth 20% of its damage for 6s.

nodes.name: Cleansing Rise
nodes.desc: Removes 2 harmful statuses from every ally. All allies = you, party members within 30 m and your followers (your own pets, summons and hired blades).

nodes.name: Pulse of Return
nodes.desc: On cast, strikes everything within 6 m of you for 150% weapon damage as holy.

nodes.name: Undying Company
nodes.desc: Cooldown 15% longer. For 8s, your followers: cannot drop below 1 health. Your followers = your own pets, summons and hired blades, never other players.

nodes.name: Grace Given
nodes.desc: Your next 2 skills within 10s cost no mana.

nodes.name: Aegis
nodes.desc: Casting it gives you a barrier worth 35% of its damage for 8s.

nodes.name: Moving Sanctuary
nodes.desc: The zone: lasts 4s instead of 6s; Places a zone 10 m across around you for 4s.

nodes.name: Small Mercy
nodes.desc: Cooldown 40% shorter. The zone: Places a zone 6 m across where you aim for 6s.

nodes.name: Echo
nodes.desc: 1 cast in 6 fires a second time, free.

nodes.name: Searing Ground
nodes.desc: The zone: striking 3 enemies within 5 m every 1s for 25% weapon damage.

nodes.name: Hushed Ground
nodes.desc: The zone: applying Weakened (deals 30% less damage) to enemies inside while they stay in it.

nodes.name: Shelter
nodes.desc: The zone: enemy ranged hits on anyone within 5 m of its middle are stopped.

nodes.name: Sanctified Rest

nodes.name: Bulwark
nodes.desc: Casting it gives you a barrier worth 20% of its damage for 6s.

nodes.desc: All allies get a barrier worth 15% of your maximum health for 6s. All allies = you, party members within 30 m and your followers (your own pets, summons and hired blades).

nodes.name: Twin Sanctuary
nodes.desc: Holds 2 charges; the cooldown brings them back one at a time.

nodes.name: Aegis
nodes.desc: Casting it gives you a barrier worth 35% of its damage for 8s.

nodes.name: Twin Lights
nodes.desc: The summon: Summons 2 Guardian Lights for 12s.

nodes.name: Clearing Light
nodes.desc: Removes 1 harmful status from every ally. All allies = you, party members within 30 m and your followers (your own pets, summons and hired blades).

nodes.name: Echo
nodes.desc: 1 cast in 6 fires a second time, free.

nodes.name: Lantern Death
nodes.desc: The summon: when it ends it bursts for 80% weapon damage within 8 m.

nodes.name: Searing Lamp
nodes.desc: On cast, applies Weakened (deals 20% less damage) for 4s to everything within 6 m of you.

nodes.name: Bulwark
nodes.desc: Casting it gives you a barrier worth 20% of its damage for 6s.

nodes.name: Lamp Bearer
nodes.desc: Places a zone 8 m across on the aimed enemy, following it for 10s, applying Marked (takes 15% more damage) to enemies inside while they stay in it.

nodes.name: Lamplighter
nodes.desc: Casting this takes 4s off Mend's cooldown. Without Mend on your bar, 6s comes off this skill's own cooldown instead. Works with Mend.

nodes.name: Choir
nodes.desc: Holds 2 charges; the cooldown brings them back one at a time.

nodes.name: Last Light
nodes.desc: Cooldown 50% longer. For 12s: the first killing blow leaves you at 1 health and ends it.

nodes.name: Aegis
nodes.desc: Casting it gives you a barrier worth 35% of its damage for 8s.

nodes.name: Drawn to Judgement
nodes.desc: Pulls targets 3 m toward the point of impact.

nodes.name: Shackling Light
nodes.desc: Also applies Rooted for 1.5s.

nodes.name: Branding
nodes.desc: What it hits takes 20% more damage from every source for 6s.

nodes.name: Weighed
nodes.desc: Deals 100% more damage to targets below 30% health.

nodes.name: Lingering Dawn
nodes.desc: Marks targets with Lit for 3s: they take 10% more damage from you.

nodes.name: Lingering
nodes.desc: Leaves a 3-metre pool of its element on the ground for 4s.

nodes.name: Three Columns
nodes.desc: 40% less damage. Laid as a 12 m line from you toward where you aim, 3.5 m wide.

nodes.name: Sentence Passed
nodes.desc: A kill with this skill: 50% of the cooldown comes back.

nodes.name: Hunger
nodes.desc: Every kill it takes cuts its cooldown by 2s.

nodes.name: Last Sentence
nodes.desc: Deals 80% more damage to undead and fiends.

nodes.name: Standing Light
nodes.desc: Leaves a 3.5 m pool for 4s that deals 150% weapon damage as holy over 4s to anything standing in it.

nodes.name: Conflagration
nodes.desc: Leaves a 4.5-metre pool of its element on the ground for 6s. The burn, chill or poison it leaves lasts 3s longer.

bar.name: Mend
bar.desc: Heals you (or the party member you target) for 35% of maximum health. Every other ally heals 20% of their maximum health. Healing past your maximum becomes a barrier, up to 10% of maximum health. All allies = you, party members within 30 m and your followers (your own pets, summons and hired blades).
bar.targets: the party member you target (or you), and all allies

bar.name: Sunlance
bar.desc: Fires a 1.4 m wide beam 24 m straight ahead, striking everything in the line for 174% weapon damage as holy. Each enemy hit heals all allies 2% of maximum health. Marks targets with Lit for 3s: they take 10% more damage from you. All allies = you, party members within 30 m and your followers (your own pets, summons and hired blades).

bar.name: Raise the Fallen
bar.desc: Raises every fallen party member within 30 m at 50% health. 4s cast: moving cancels it and nothing is spent. Cannot be cast while a monster is attacking you. The fallen player chooses whether to stand up. Gives you Rallied: you deal 20% more damage and take 15% less damage for 8s. All allies get the same. Every other ally heals 30% of their maximum health. Revives all your own fallen followers at once at 50% health. All allies = you, party members within 30 m and your followers (your own pets, summons and hired blades).
bar.targets: every fallen party member within 30 m

bar.name: Sanctuary
bar.desc: Lands on a spot up to 20 m away. Places a zone 10 m across where you aim for 6s, healing all allies inside 3% of maximum health every 1s, pushing enemies inside 2 m outward every second. All allies = you, party members within 30 m and your followers (your own pets, summons and hired blades).

bar.name: Guardian Light
bar.desc: Summons 1 Guardian Light for 20s; it takes no follower slot; it heals the most-hurt ally 6% every 2s. All allies = you, party members within 30 m and your followers (your own pets, summons and hired blades).

bar.name: Falling Light
bar.desc: Falls on a spot up to 28 m away, 0.7s after you cast, striking everything within 3.5 m of that spot for 864% weapon damage as holy. Places a zone 7 m across where you aim for 1s, healing all allies inside 10% of maximum health every 1s. Deals 50% more damage to Lit targets. All allies = you, party members within 30 m and your followers (your own pets, summons and hired blades).

core.label: Level
core.tip: Your level.

core.label: Health
core.tip: Your maximum health: your level, Constitution and gear.

core.label: Mana
core.tip: Your maximum mana: your level, Intelligence and gear.

core.label: Weapon damage (low)
core.tip: The lowest a basic hit rolls before the target's armour. Every ability's "weapon damage" is a share of this roll.

core.label: Weapon damage (high)
core.tip: The highest a basic hit rolls before the target's armour.

core.label: Attacks per second
core.tip: How often your basic attack lands: one every 0.65 s with what you are holding. Attack speed bonuses raise it (up to +40% in all).

core.label: Critical chance
core.tip: The chance a hit is a critical hit.

core.label: Critical damage
core.tip: How much more a critical hit deals.

core.label: Spell power
core.tip: Added to every hit that is not physical: fire, ice, lightning, poison, shadow, holy, arcane.

core.label: Armour
core.tip: Physical hits on you are reduced by 35% (armour / (100 + armour)).

core.label: Physical damage reduced
core.tip: From your 55 armour: armour / (100 + armour). One more point of armour is worth about 0.4% here; each point is worth a little less than the one before.

core.label: Dodge
core.tip: The chance a hit misses you entirely (never more than 35%).

core.label: Health regeneration
core.tip: Health restored every second, in or out of a fight. Out of a fight you also mend 1.5% of your health a second.

core.label: Mana regeneration
core.tip: Mana restored every second. Out of a fight you also regain 2% of your mana a second.

core.label: Move speed
core.tip: How fast you run on foot.

core.label: Strength
core.tip: Raises the damage of weapons that scale with Strength.

core.label: Dexterity
core.tip: Raises the damage of weapons that scale with Dexterity, and your dodge.

core.label: Intelligence
core.tip: Raises the damage of weapons that scale with Intelligence, and your mana.

core.label: Constitution
core.tip: Raises your maximum health.

advanced.label: Magic resistance
advanced.tip: Reduces magical hits on you the way armour reduces physical ones.

advanced.label: Block chance
advanced.tip: The chance a hit on you is blocked.

advanced.label: Barrier
advanced.tip: A shield of this much damage from your off-hand focus; it regenerates out of a fight.

advanced.label: Barrier regeneration
advanced.tip: How fast that barrier comes back.

advanced.label: Attack speed
advanced.tip: Faster basic attacks — melee, bows, wands, tomes and staves alike. All bonuses together count up to the cap shown on "Attacks per second".

advanced.label: Cooldown reduction
advanced.tip: Taken off every ability's cooldown.

advanced.label: Attack area
advanced.tip: Bigger swings, cones and blasts.

advanced.label: Flat damage
advanced.tip: Added to every hit before multipliers.

advanced.label: Magic find
advanced.tip: Better odds of a rarer drop.

advanced.label: Gold find
advanced.tip: More gold from kills.

active.name: Two Good Legs
active.text: You've a weapon and two good legs, which makes you the most useful person in Torborhold this week. armour.name: Chapel Mail
armour.blurb: Mail chest, mail helm and mail boots. Nothing on: legs, gloves.
armour.diff: A deeper well: more mana, and it comes back faster.

armour.name: Almoner's Coat
armour.blurb: Leather chest, mail helm and leather boots. Nothing on: legs, gloves.

armour.name: Wayside Robe
armour.blurb: Cloth chest, cloth helm and leather boots. Nothing on: legs, gloves.
armour.diff: Safer: more health and resistance to magic.

weapons.name: Plain Sceptre
weapons.blurb: Sceptre: one-handed, MELEE; its swings deal arcane force damage, with a shield in the off hand (armour and a chance to block).

items.name: Arc Scepter
items.weaponLine: A one-handed sceptre, attuned to Arc, swung in melee. It can go in either hand, or one in each.
items.handNote: It can go in either hand, or one in each.
items.elementNote: Arc — plain arcane damage, and the one element that leaves no status on the target.
items.attackText: Basic attack: a melee swing that deals arcane damage instead of physical. It never throws a bolt.

weapons.role: Weapon and shield · steady, close, arcane
weapons.diff: One hand strikes, the other blocks. Its swings deal elemental damage, up close.

weapons.name: Staff of the Circle
weapons.blurb: Staff: two-handed; its attack is a ring of arcane force around you.

items.name: Arc Staff
items.weaponLine: A two-handed staff, attuned to Arc. Its attack is a spell, not a swing. It takes both hands, so the off hand stays empty.
items.handNote: It takes both hands, so the off hand stays empty.
items.elementNote: Arc — plain arcane damage, and the one element that leaves no status on the target.
items.castLine: Arc Burst — area surrounding you, cast instead of a swing. A tap is free; holding it builds the spell and spends mana.
items.attackText: Basic attack (Arc Burst): strikes everything within 5.5 m of you for 95% weapon damage. Costs no mana; hold the attack to charge it with mana: a dome that shoves everything out when it pops.

weapons.role: Spell staff · steady, around you, arcane
weapons.diff: A two-handed staff: your basic attack is its spell. A ring that bursts around you.

weapons.name: Winter Crook
weapons.blurb: Staff: two-handed; its attack is a short cone of frost in front of you.

items.name: Rime Staff
items.weaponLine: A two-handed staff, attuned to Rime. Its attack is a spell, not a swing. It takes both hands, so the off hand stays empty.
items.handNote: It takes both hands, so the off hand stays empty.
items.elementNote: Rime — a hit also sets Chilled, and the target moves 45% slower for 4s.
items.castLine: Rime Cone — a cone in front of you, cast instead of a swing. A tap is free; holding it builds the spell and spends mana.
items.attackText: Basic attack (Rime Cone): a 57° cone 8 m long in front of you for 80% weapon damage to everything in it. Hits leave Chilled. Costs no mana; hold the attack to charge it with mana: held down, it becomes a jet.

weapons.role: Spell staff · steady, short range, frost
weapons.diff: A two-handed staff: your basic attack is its spell. A short cone in front of you.

weapons.name: Warding Wand and Psalter
weapons.blurb: Wand: one-handed, ranged; throws a bolt of arcane force; each hit gives you a small barrier, with a psalter (a focus: spell power and mana).

items.name: Arc Wand
items.weaponLine: A one-handed wand, attuned to Arc. It throws a bolt rather than swinging — about 34 m. It can go in either hand, or one in each.
items.handNote: It can go in either hand, or one in each.
items.elementNote: Arc — plain arcane damage, and the one element that leaves no status on the target.
items.castLine: Arc bolt — a single bolt, fast and straight, about 34 m.
items.attackText: Basic attack: throws one arcane bolt up to 26 m, bursting 1.3 m for 80% weapon damage. An attack that hits gives you a barrier of 2% of your maximum health (it builds up to 10%) for 4s.

items.name: Psalter
items.focusText: Held with a wand, tome or sceptre: a basic attack that hits restores 2 mana.

weapons.role: Wand and focus · quick, long range, arcane
weapons.diff: A wand casts from range; the focus beside it adds to your magic. A bolt that also shields you.

weapons.name: Lightline Wand and Orb
weapons.blurb: Wand: one-handed, ranged; fires an instant line of lightning through everything in it, with an orb in the off hand (your hits burst around the enemy struck).

items.name: Storm Wand
items.weaponLine: A one-handed wand, attuned to Storm. It throws a bolt rather than swinging — about 34 m. It can go in either hand, or one in each.
items.handNote: It can go in either hand, or one in each.
items.elementNote: Storm — a hit also sets Shocked, and the target takes 30% more damage from every source for 5s.
items.castLine: Storm bolt — a single bolt, fast and straight, about 34 m.
items.attackText: Basic attack: an instant beam of lightning 18 m long and 1.2 m wide that strikes everything along it for 75% weapon damage. Hits leave Shocked.

items.name: Blight Orb
items.weaponLine: Held in the off hand — it has no attack of its own
items.handNote: Off hand
items.elementNote: Blight — a hit also sets Poisoned, about 146% of that hit's damage again as poison damage over 8s.
items.focusText: Held with a wand, tome or sceptre: a basic attack that hits also bursts 2.5 m around the first enemy struck for 35% weapon damage.

weapons.role: Wand and focus · quick, medium range, lightning
weapons.diff: A wand casts from range; the focus beside it adds to your magic. A straight beam through everything in its line.

weapons.name: Chapel Mace and Shield
weapons.blurb: Mace: one-handed, with a shield in the off hand (armour and a chance to block).

items.name: Iron Mace

core.label: Level
core.tip: Your level.

core.label: Health
core.tip: Your maximum health: your level, Constitution and gear.

core.label: Mana
core.tip: Your maximum mana: your level, Intelligence and gear.

core.label: Weapon damage (low)
core.tip: The lowest a basic hit rolls before the target's armour. Every ability's "weapon damage" is a share of this roll.

core.label: Weapon damage (high)
core.tip: The highest a basic hit rolls before the target's armour.

core.label: Attacks per second
core.tip: How often your basic attack lands: one every 0.65 s with what you are holding. Attack speed bonuses raise it (up to +40% in all).

core.label: Critical chance
core.tip: The chance a hit is a critical hit.

core.label: Critical damage
core.tip: How much more a critical hit deals.

core.label: Spell power
core.tip: Added to every hit that is not physical: fire, ice, lightning, poison, shadow, holy, arcane.

core.label: Armour
core.tip: Physical hits on you are reduced by 35% (armour / (100 + armour)).

core.label: Physical damage reduced
core.tip: From your 55 armour: armour / (100 + armour). One more point of armour is worth about 0.4% here; each point is worth a little less than the one before.

core.label: Dodge
core.tip: The chance a hit misses you entirely (never more than 35%).

core.label: Health regeneration
core.tip: Health restored every second, in or out of a fight. Out of a fight you also mend 1.5% of your health a second.

core.label: Mana regeneration
core.tip: Mana restored every second. Out of a fight you also regain 2% of your mana a second.

core.label: Move speed
core.tip: How fast you run on foot.

core.label: Strength
core.tip: Raises the damage of weapons that scale with Strength.

core.label: Dexterity
core.tip: Raises the damage of weapons that scale with Dexterity, and your dodge.

core.label: Intelligence
core.tip: Raises the damage of weapons that scale with Intelligence, and your mana.

core.label: Constitution
core.tip: Raises your maximum health.

advanced.label: Magic resistance
advanced.tip: Reduces magical hits on you the way armour reduces physical ones.

advanced.label: Block chance
advanced.tip: The chance a hit on you is blocked.

advanced.label: Barrier
advanced.tip: A shield of this much damage from your off-hand focus; it regenerates out of a fight.

advanced.label: Barrier regeneration
advanced.tip: How fast that barrier comes back.

advanced.label: Attack speed
advanced.tip: Faster basic attacks — melee, bows, wands, tomes and staves alike. All bonuses together count up to the cap shown on "Attacks per second".

advanced.label: Cooldown reduction
advanced.tip: Taken off every ability's cooldown.

advanced.label: Attack area
advanced.tip: Bigger swings, cones and blasts.

advanced.label: Flat damage
advanced.tip: Added to every hit before multipliers.

advanced.label: Magic find
advanced.tip: Better odds of a rarer drop.

advanced.label: Gold find
advanced.tip: More gold from kills.

says: Half the watch is down with the cough and the other half is scared of a man called Hobb.

m.name: Elder Maud Torbor
says: You've a sword and two good legs. That makes you the most useful person in Torborhold this week.

offers.name: Night watch: marsh wisps
offers.text: marsh wisps come in after dark. Stand watch until dawn and see them off.

offers.name: Herbs near The Pail and Plough
offers.text: The healer needs herbs that only grow near The Pail and Plough. They're the green ones. Most are green.

steps.text: Herbs near The Pail and Plough

offers.name: The big sky cultists
offers.text: There's one sky cultists bigger than the rest, and it's teaching the others bad habits.

offers.name: Too many cult zealots
offers.text: There are more cult zealots around The Torbor Fields than anyone has ever seen. Thin them out.

m.name: Bryn the Bonesetter
says: Sit. No, not there, that's where I keep the leeches.

offers.name: Into Barrow entrance
offers.text: Something keeps coming up out of Barrow entrance. Go down one floor and push it back.

offers.name: Hands for the harvest at Mawehaven Farm
offers.text: Mawehaven Farm cannot bring the harvest in with sky cultists prowling the edges. Keep them off while the carts load.

steps.text: Hands for the harvest at Mawehaven Farm

offers.name: Trouble at Wamonhold Orchard
offers.text: bog slimes have got into Wamonhold Orchard and the farmer is losing more than sleep. Clear them out.

offers.name: The big dusk flitters
offers.text: There's one dusk flitters bigger than the rest, and it's teaching the others bad habits.

add.name: Hazel Rod
add.desc: A hazel switch, a length of line and a hook. A Tool: it takes no weapon slot. Lets you fish any water.

m.name: Tam Sedgeley
m.text: Tam Sedgeley shows you how to fish. You have learned Angling and been handed a rod.

m.name: Tam Sedgeley
says: Ever held a rod? No? Good. No bad habits to fix. See the ripples, just south of where I'm standing? That's the town pool. It never fishes out.

offers.name: A Line in the Water
offers.text: See that patch of river where the water can't sit still? That's a fish pool: more fish than sense. Take this rod, it's hazel and it owes me nothing. Walk down, face the water, cast, and wait for the float to dip. Then pull. Not before. Everyone pulls before.
offers.done: Three! And only one of them looks surprised to be here. Keep the rod. Anywhere there's water you can cast, but the pools are where the good ones crowd, and they move about once you've thinned them.

steps.text: Walk to the fish pool Tam pointed out
steps.where: the rippling water on the river by Torborhold, a short walk along the bank from Tam

steps.text: Catch 3 fish from a fish pool
steps.where: any fish pool: ripples and jumping fish on the river by Torborhold
Tam Sedgeley, on the river bank by Torborhold

reward.text: The Hazel Rod is yours to keep, with a tin of worms and a crate of somebody's lost gear Tam hooked last spring.

offers.name: Three Fen Stickleback for the pan
offers.text: The inn wants Fen Stickleback for tonight and I have a rod, a bad back and no time. Bring me three.

steps.text: Three Fen Stickleback for the pan

offers.name: Work the pools
offers.text: See the rings on the water, where the Redfin Roach jump? That is a pool. Land five catches from pools in The Torbor Fields before somebody else empties them.

offers.name: A proper Lantern Eel
offers.text: Anyone can catch gudgeon. Bring me one Lantern Eel from The Torbor Fields and I will stop saying that about you.

offers.name: The Pale Carp that got away
offers.text: I had a Pale Carp on the line for an hour. An hour! Land one, show me, and I will finally be able to sleep.

steps.text: The Pale Carp that got away

m.text: Tam Sedgeley shows you how to fish. You have learned Angling and been handed a rod.

m.name: Tam Sedgeley
says: Ever held a rod? No? Good. No bad habits to fix. See the ripples, just south of where I'm standing? That's the town pool. It never fishes out.

offers.name: A Line in the Water
offers.text: See that patch of river where the water can't sit still? That's a fish pool: more fish than sense. Take this rod, it's hazel and it owes me nothing. Walk down, face the water, cast, and wait for the float to dip. Then pull. Not before. Everyone pulls before.
offers.done: Three! And only one of them looks surprised to be here. Keep the rod. Anywhere there's water you can cast, but the pools are where the good ones crowd, and they move about once you've thinned them.

core.label: Level
core.tip: Your level.

core.label: Health
core.tip: Your maximum health: your level, Constitution and gear.

core.label: Mana
core.tip: Your maximum mana: your level, Intelligence and gear.

core.label: Weapon damage (low)
core.tip: The lowest a basic hit rolls before the target's armour. Every ability's "weapon damage" is a share of this roll.

core.label: Weapon damage (high)
core.tip: The highest a basic hit rolls before the target's armour.

core.label: Attacks per second
core.tip: How often your basic attack lands: one every 0.65 s with what you are holding. Attack speed bonuses raise it (up to +40% in all).

core.label: Critical chance
core.tip: The chance a hit is a critical hit.

core.label: Critical damage
core.tip: How much more a critical hit deals.

core.label: Spell power
core.tip: Added to every hit that is not physical: fire, ice, lightning, poison, shadow, holy, arcane.

core.label: Armour
core.tip: Physical hits on you are reduced by 35% (armour / (100 + armour)).

core.label: Physical damage reduced
core.tip: From your 55 armour: armour / (100 + armour). One more point of armour is worth about 0.4% here; each point is worth a little less than the one before.

core.label: Dodge
core.tip: The chance a hit misses you entirely (never more than 35%).

core.label: Health regeneration
core.tip: Health restored every second, in or out of a fight. Out of a fight you also mend 1.5% of your health a second.

core.label: Mana regeneration
core.tip: Mana restored every second. Out of a fight you also regain 2% of your mana a second.

core.label: Move speed
core.tip: How fast you run on foot.

core.label: Strength
core.tip: Raises the damage of weapons that scale with Strength.

core.label: Dexterity
core.tip: Raises the damage of weapons that scale with Dexterity, and your dodge.

core.label: Intelligence
core.tip: Raises the damage of weapons that scale with Intelligence, and your mana.

core.label: Constitution
core.tip: Raises your maximum health.

advanced.label: Magic resistance
advanced.tip: Reduces magical hits on you the way armour reduces physical ones.

advanced.label: Block chance
advanced.tip: The chance a hit on you is blocked.

advanced.label: Barrier
advanced.tip: A shield of this much damage from your off-hand focus; it regenerates out of a fight.

advanced.label: Barrier regeneration
advanced.tip: How fast that barrier comes back.

advanced.label: Attack speed
advanced.tip: Faster basic attacks — melee, bows, wands, tomes and staves alike. All bonuses together count up to the cap shown on "Attacks per second".

advanced.label: Cooldown reduction
advanced.tip: Taken off every ability's cooldown.

advanced.label: Attack area
advanced.tip: Bigger swings, cones and blasts.

advanced.label: Flat damage
advanced.tip: Added to every hit before multipliers.

advanced.label: Magic find
advanced.tip: Better odds of a rarer drop.

advanced.label: Gold find
advanced.tip: More gold from kills.
